items.item: Filters include the period, with presets (this month, last month, custom range), and at least one dimension; the applied period is stated in the title or a summary line (such as "Revenue · October 2026")
items.evidence: Period preset group with data-preset="this-month"/"last-month"/"this-quarter"/"this-year"/"custom" (lines 109-113) plus month-range inputs for custom; Customer and Product dimension filter popovers (#btn-filter-customer, #btn-filter-product); title reads 'Revenue · November 2026' (line 86), confirmed in screenshot.

items.item: Amounts are right-aligned in tabular figures, formatted as currency with consistent decimals, and negative values use a minus sign or parentheses rather than colour alone
items.evidence: Table cells use class 'text-right tabular-nums' (right-aligned, tabular — confirmed by audit.json numericCells.misaligned:0/nonTabular:0), but row amounts use fmtAmount()=nfAmount (plain Intl.NumberFormat, no currency style), rendering as bare numbers like '115,498' / '535,500' with no $ symbol — only the column header 'Revenue (USD)' and page subtitle carry currency; only the summary line ('$535,500 total revenue') and chart use fmtMoneySymbol. Deltas do correctly combine a +/- sign (nfDelta signDisplay:'exceptZero') with colour (deltaClass), so that sub-part is fine, but the primary amount column is not currency-formatted.

items.item: Every comparison names its base and period (such as "+12.4% vs Sep 2026"), and a missing base shows "—" rather than Infinity, NaN or 100%
items.evidence: Column headers are built dynamically as 'vs ' + prevLabel / 'vs ' + lyLabel (buildTheadHtml, lines 467-468), rendering e.g. 'vs Oct 2026' and 'vs Nov 2025' (seen in screenshot); fmtDelta(v) returns '—' when v is null (line 259), used for missing-base cases instead of Infinity/NaN/100%.

items.item: A totals row equals the sum of the rows, with subtotals when rows are grouped, and stays visibly separate from the data rows
items.evidence: tfoot row sums grandTotal = currTotal*otherMult*thisMult which equals the sum of all row.revenue values (computeRows, lines 320-335); tfoot styled with 'border-t-2 border-slate-300 font-medium' (line 567) visually separating it from tbody; screenshot shows Total=535,500 matching sum of listed customer rows. Rows aren't grouped so no subtotal tier is needed.

items.item: Columns are sortable with the active sort shown (aria-sort), and the default order is meaningful, such as revenue from high to low
items.evidence: thSort() sets aria-sort="ascending"/"descending" on the active column's <th> (line 457) and onHeaderClick cycles sort state (lines 477-483); default state.sort is {key:'revenue', dir:'desc'} (line 359), and the screenshot shows rows already ordered from $115,498 down to $15,400 with a chevron-down icon on 'Revenue (USD)'.

items.item: Export downloads the current filtered view, and printing gives a clean report without the sidebar, buttons or filters
items.evidence: doExport() reads lastRendered[state.activeTab], which stores the currently sorted/filtered rows and totals, and builds CSV/XLS from that (lines 645-657); print CSS hides elements marked .no-print (aside sidebar line 47, header line 70, filter bar line 106, print/export buttons line 89, chart section line 154) via '@media print { .no-print { display:none !important } }' (line 15), leaving the data table visible.

items.item: The page states when the data was last updated and the currency (and tax basis, if any) of the figures
items.evidence: Subtitle text: "Amounts in USD, before tax · Updated <time datetime="2026-11-06T08:00:00-05:00">11/06/2026 8:00 AM</time>" (line 87) states currency (USD), tax basis (before tax), and last-updated timestamp.

items.item: A period with no data shows an empty state; loading and an error with retry are present
items.evidence: emptyRowHtml() renders an inbox icon, message, and 'Change period' button (lines 504-510), reachable e.g. via an invalid custom range ('Select a valid date range.'); errorRowHtml() renders an alert icon, message, and #retry-<dim> button (lines 497-503); skeletonRowsHtml() with tbody[aria-busy=true] renders animated placeholder rows during initial load (lines 484-496, 531-534, 546-550).

items.item: Any chart has a text or table equivalent, and no pie or donut chart is used for more than five categories
items.evidence: Line chart is an SVG with role="img" and a computed aria-label summary (lines 612-617), plus a 'Show table' toggle button (#toggle-chart-table) that reveals #chart-table, a full data table of the same 12 months (lines 619-622). No pie/donut chart is used anywhere.

notes: Clean, restrained implementation (plain Tailwind, SVG icon sprite, no gradients/glass/emoji). Avatar 'AT' is a real named user (title="Alex Tran"), not a non-person entity, so not counted as initials-avatar-non-person. Main defect found: the primary Revenue column is rendered with plain Intl number formatting (no $ symbol) rather than a currency format, relying only on the column header '(USD)' label and the separate summary line's $-formatted total.
